sentences.text: This matter is taken up through hybrid arrangement.

2. Since this case relates to the offences under Sections 376 of the IPC read with section 6 of the POCSO Act, notice needs to be issued to the informant.
3.

Accordingly, learned counsel for the Petitioner is directed to serve required numbers of copies of the BLAPL on the learned Additional Standing Counsel for the State within three working days hence in order to enable her to serve notice upon the informant through the concerned Investigating Officer regarding hearing of the bail application.

4. List this matter on 20.01.2026.
